messages.author: 7edb8a804bcba41f
messages.subject: item fit statistics
parts:
Hello,
I've been using the M2 function to get limited information model fit statistics for ordinal IRT models. I've been reading Goodness-of-Fit Assessment of IRT Models and am interested in retrieving z statistic results as shown in Table 4 (p.91) of this article to better understand which items may be causing problems. Can MIRT produce this statistic? Using a graded response model, I've been able to produce the residual correlations (bottom part of the matrix in Table 4) but not the results shown in the diagonal or upper matrix. Thanks in advance for any assistance.
All the best,
Shimon

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: item fit statistics
parts:
Thank you for the reference. These bivariate/univariate statistics seem reasonably easy to compute, though currently I don't think they can be obtained from the possible output from M2(). The change will have to be an internal one. I'll add it to the TODO list for those who are interested.

Phil
